guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Perpl website
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect your wallet
guide.description: Click “Connect Wallet” and approve the connection with MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund your wallet with stablecoins
guide.description: Perpl uses AUSD as its collateral asset, but you can start from USDC or USDT. If you need funds, you can buy them on Bybit and withdraw them to your wallet. Open the deposit flow on the Perpl app. If you hold USDC, USDT, or another supported coin, Perpl’s built-in bridge converts it to AUSD during the deposit. A minimum of 10 AUSD is required to open an account.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade perps to earn weekly points
guide.description: Open and close leveraged positions on any listed market. Your organic trading activity earns both Perpl Points and mPoints each week. Snapshots are taken Wednesdays at 16:00 UTC, and points are credited by the following Monday.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Add or generate a referral code
guide.description: Use our referral link for a permanent +5% boost on both Perpl Points and mPoints. Once your own volume passes $10,000, you unlock a personal link that earns 10% of your direct referrals’ fees, 5% from sub-referrals, and a 5% points boost, processed biweekly.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Join the Monad Cards Invitational
guide.description: The $100k Monad Cards Invitational runs until mid-August 2026. Make at least one trade during the tournament period to receive a soulbound badge NFT, and compete on PnL and volume for prizes. Entry is open to Monad Card holders and pre-snapshot Perpl Points holders.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check your balances every Monday
guide.description: Visit the points page and the mPoints tab weekly to confirm your distributions arrived and track your projected MON earnings.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
